errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the color of the WEBQUESTIO slice as blue, when it is actually teal or cyan.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the TRIVIAQA slice as blue, when it is actually orange.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the TREC slice as orange, when it is actually green.
The label in the chart is 'POPQA', but the description incorrectly writes it with a hyphen as 'POP-QA'.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the HOTPOTQA slice as yellow, when it is actually red.
The description states that the percentage labels are displayed within each slice, but the chart shows them outside the pie, with lines pointing to the respective slices.

errors.text_span: the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the slices are ordered by size. Visually, they are not arranged in descending order; for example, the slice for TRIVIAQA (22.7%) is placed between TREC (1.9%) and WEBQUESTIO (3.6%) when viewed clockwise starting from the bottom.
